evidence: Conditional economic scenario for a proposed resident league. Costs, paid demand, retention, staffing, import shares and capital are assumptions, not observations or quotations. Physical mechanics are separate numerical screens. No league, safe sport, customer contract or financing is established.
reading_rule: Consolidate lunar league and clubs; count only receipts reaching them. Foreign distributor turnover and internal grants are excluded. No tourism. U is the existing real accounting numeraire with no conversion to current USD. Near term denotes an early hosted settlement, without a forecast calendar date. Imported renewal is included in the trade memo; supplier imported content is an assumption; household imports and the rest of the settlement are outside it.

assumption_basis.season: One shared resident venue; 48 regular matches plus 3 playoffs, with 32 athletes and 24 other workers. Eight-person training groups are scheduling assumptions, not collision-safe capacities. Rest, illness, medical coverage and event-day staffing require qualification.
assumption_basis.costs: Separated wages and purchased services; host lease includes accommodation, utilities and shared services. Facility operations and event services exclude those host charges and employee wages. All amounts are conditional allowances; no installed habitat or delivery quote.
assumption_basis.rights: 20 U owner yield may represent 40 U consumer payment with half retained offworld. Annual paid audience is averaged over the year. Steady annual churn replaced at 8 U per acquired customer; commissioning acquires the entire audience separately. Sponsorship excludes distributor ad inventory already in rights yield; royalties exclude licensee gross sales.
assumption_basis.scale: Global-niche case keeps the same athletes and events but doubles wages and installed capital and raises variable commercial services to 25% of remote receipts. It is a capacity-held scenario, not an empirical scale law.
assumption_basis.capital: Incremental dedicated arena/production investment only; host construction, passenger transport and construction interest are excluded. Twenty-year blended replacement life is an assumption. Initial customer acquisition is expensed commissioning cash, not league capital value.
assumption_basis.finance: Illustrative fixed debt for stress comparisons; no underwriting or investor demand established. 20% tax allowance before interest deduction and no loss relief. The reserve and working cash are not drawn in operating cases.
assumption_basis.fan_support: Ten, one hundred and five hundred million fans are conditional audience scales, not forecasts. Twenty percent buy viewing; five percent buy additional membership services and are a subset of paid viewers. Net royalties average 1 U and sponsorship 0.5 U across all fans. Every case spends 35% of remote receipts on commercial/production services and at least 20% on employee compensation; enlarged capital is independently funded. One percent donate 20 U annually, recorded as transfers; 0.2% make a one-time 250 U investment, recorded as financing. Neither is revenue, and repeat investment is not assumed.
assumption_basis.touring: Four candidate competition families, eight club or athlete organizations each, eight registered athletes per organization, one resident and seven visiting. These roster/event units are a common costing template, not sport rules. Two 56-night visits per visiting person per year with two competitions at once; Earth-based homes and preparation remain possible. Initial capital includes two dedicated arenas and 200 guest beds but not the host settlement. Return fares are real-U scenarios without transport quotations or qualified route capacity. Visitors are modeled as nonresident employees performing on the Moon; compensation is lunar value added and an outward income payment. Audience cohorts count bundles once across sports.
